parameters.name: Area
parameters.description:
The name of the region. To get a list of supported regions, call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation.

- If you omit this parameter, data for all regions is returned.

- You can specify one or more regions, separated by commas.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain names to query. Separate multiple domain names with commas.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: HttpCode
parameters.description:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

- **2xx**: 2xx status codes.

- **3xx**: 3xx status codes.

- **4xx**: 4xx status codes.

- **5xx**: 5xx status codes.

If you do not specify this parameter, data for all supported HTTP status codes is returned.

parameters.name: IsOverseas
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the region is outside the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

- **1**: A region outside the Chinese mainland.

- **0**: The Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ReportId
parameters.description: The ID of the report to query. You can specify only one report ID per call. To query report IDs, call the [DescribeCdnSubList](~~271655~~) operation.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
